content.name: Patient Defense
entries: You can spend 1 ki point to take the {@action Dodge} action as a bonus action on your turn.

content.name: Patient Defense
entries: You can take the {@action Disengage|SRD52} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}. Alternatively, you can expend 1 Focus Point to take both the {@action Disengage|SRD52} and the {@action Dodge|SRD52} actions as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}.
